grades.quote: Each page of virtual memory address space maps to an underlying page frame of physical memory or to none.
grades.reason: Directly explains the key distinction: virtual pages can lack physical backing, so sparse gaps need not consume physical page frames.

grades.quote: Each process has its own kernel stack, which is mapped at a high kernel virtual address so that below it xv6 can leave an unmapped _guard page_ .
grades.reason: Illustrates high-address mappings and unmapped gaps, but does not directly explain the general relationship between sparse address-space span and physical-memory consumption.
